sql:
SELECT
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    (p.UnitPrice - p.UnitCost) * 100.0 / nullIf(p.UnitPrice, 0) AS profit_margin_pct
FROM retail.DimProduct AS p
WHERE p.UnitPrice IS NOT NULL
  AND p.UnitCost IS NOT NULL
  AND p.UnitPrice != 0
ORDER BY profit_margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 10
